$comment: Settings schema for the OptiScaler-FFXIV fork: the machine-readable reference of fork ini keys. One entry per key; adding a key later is one local entry here. tools/gen-settings.ps1 reads this file and writes docs/SETTINGS.md; -Check mode verifies the committed file is up to date. Format vocabularies: type = bool|int|float|enum|string; applies = live (menu change applies at once) | restart (game restart) | start (read once at start); menu = {tab, card} of OptiScaler/ext/core/MenuLayout.h, or iniOnly with the reason (those keys are also listed in kIniOnlyKeys of OptiScaler/ext/core/MenuManifest.h). Every new key defaults to today's behaviour (default auto).

keys.name: Mode
keys.description: HUD-less frame generation (DLSS-G): keep the HUD sharp in fast camera motion. FFXIV only. off = today's behaviour; recomposition = DLSS-G recomposes the UI itself (applies after a game restart); ui_free = frame generation runs on the UI-free image and the UI is pasted back at the real frame rate. Any other value counts as off.

keys.name: MaskThreshold
keys.description: Advanced: largest per-channel difference (0..1) between the final and the UI-free frame that still counts as the same pixel.

keys.name: MaskDilation
keys.description: Advanced: grow the detected UI area by this many pixels.

keys.name: PasteCleanup
keys.description: Advanced: also paste where the previous frame had UI and this one does not (clears the ghost of UI that just closed).

keys.name: SteadyTiming
keys.description: Advanced: paste the UI of one real frame behind (steadier world-anchored UI, slightly older).

keys.name: CoverageGuard
keys.description: Advanced: fall back to normal frame generation when more than this share (0..1) of the pixels is flagged as UI for 5 measurements in a row (full-screen fades, a ReShade preset before the capture). 0 = off. While fallen back the UI-free image keeps being measured, and the guard returns after 30 measurements in a row at or below 0.75x this value, or after 120 presents with no new measurement.

keys.name: ShowDetectedUi
keys.description: Debug: tint the pasted UI area.

keys.name: ReShadePresets
keys.defaultMeans: auto (on when a ReShade runtime with an enabled technique registered)
keys.description: Apply ReShade presets in place at the UI boundary, so the UI-free image has them and the HUD stays unfiltered. auto = when ReShade registered a runtime and at least one technique is enabled; on = always try; off = never. Switching to off applies at once; switching back to on after the game started with off needs a restart.

keys.name: GuardMode

menu.iniOnly: opt-in guard policy not tried in a game: kept out of the menu until it has been

keys.description: Developer switch, ini only: how the coverage guard trips and releases. legacy = as described under CoverageGuard. density = trips when 3 of the last 12 measurements are over the limit, returns only after 60 measurements in a row at or below 0.75 x the limit. Any other value counts as legacy.

keys.name: GuardReleaseHolds

menu.iniOnly: opt-in time limit of the density guard, which has not been tried in a game

keys.description: Developer switch, ini only, density guard only: 0 = off. With N above 0 the guard leaves the fallback after N anchor-later frames in a row whose window had no measurement over the release level, even though the 60-measurement clean run cannot complete while they keep coming. The guard trips again by the normal rule.

keys.name: GuardTripOnAnchorLater

menu.iniOnly: opt-in per-frame trip of the density guard, which has not been tried in a game

keys.description: Developer switch, ini only, density guard only: a frame the game anchored after off-screen UI draws trips the guard at once, so the base of that very frame is not swapped, instead of waiting about two presents for its measurement. The trip then ends by the normal release rules.

keys.name: HdrPaste

menu.iniOnly: opt-in for a GPU path no HDR user has confirmed yet: kept out of the menu until one does

keys.description: Developer switch, ini only: with HDR output and Mode = ui_free, make the paste's HDR stage before the first paste image. Without it that image is never built and ui_free stays on normal frame generation under HDR output.

keys.name: Diagnostics

menu.iniOnly: shows the HUD-less diagnostics card of the FFXIV tab; observation only

keys.description: Developer gate, ini only: switch on the game-side UI boundary detector's observation (draw tracking and the shader registry), show the HUD-less diagnostics card of the FFXIV tab and turn on the ReShade add-on probe. Observation only, it does not change the frame. Set it before the game starts.

keys.name: ReShadeProbe

menu.iniOnly: shows the ReShade add-on probe card

keys.description: Developer gate, ini only: the ReShade add-on also subscribes to the effect-runtime events, writes reshade-probe.txt and shows the diagnostics card. Set it before the game starts.

keys.name: PlateDiagnostics

menu.iniOnly: developer probes (log only) of the output stream and the UI draws

keys.description: Developer switch, ini only: log-only probes measuring what frame generation delivers and which UI draws could be nameplates. Output goes to OptiScaler/plate-probe/<run>/. Nothing in the frame changes. Set it before the game starts.

keys.name: FfxivHDR
keys.description: OptiHDR (FFXIV): HDR10 output for the D3D11 game through the DX12 presenter. Needs Windows HDR enabled on the game display before launch, and works with DLSS-G, XeFG, or with frame generation off. Restart after changing.

keys.name: Mode
keys.description: 0 = SDR expansion (the game's SDR image is expanded to HDR10), 1 = scene HDR (the game's tonemap stages are replayed in FP16 next to the SDR chain; the SDR chain, ReShade and the HUD are untouched).

keys.name: PeakNits
keys.description: Peak brightness of the HDR output, in nits.

keys.name: PaperWhiteNits
keys.description: Paper-white brightness of the HDR output, in nits. Never above PeakNits.

keys.name: HighlightExpansion
keys.description: Mode 0: how far above paper white the SDR highlights are expanded (0 = none, 1 = up to PeakNits).

keys.name: Contrast
keys.description: Output grading applied before PQ encoding: contrast.

keys.name: Saturation
keys.description: Output grading applied before PQ encoding: saturation.

keys.name: Vibrance
keys.description: Output grading applied before PQ encoding: vibrance.

keys.name: NRSceneInput
keys.description: Mode 1: run NR on the linear HDR scene instead of the SDR colour. Experimental. Needs NR before upscaling or PreSR.

keys.name: DLSSSceneInput
keys.description: Feed native scene HDR through DLSS w/Dx12 before SDR ReShade processing. Experimental; enable RenoDX scene HDR and restart after changing.

keys.name: ScreenshotKey
keys.description: Optional screenshot key (Windows virtual-key code). -1 leaves it unbound.

keys.name: ScreenshotFormat
keys.description: Save one PNG: 0 = SDR for sharing (default), 1 = HDR. Requires OptiHDR active.

keys.name: ScreenshotIccOnly
keys.description: Use BT.2100 PQ ICC metadata without an outer PNG cICP chunk for HDR sharing. HDR pixel values are preserved. Viewer compatibility varies.

keys.name: ScreenshotMenu
keys.description: HDR PNG only: while the menu is open, capture the presented image after the menu was drawn onto it, including its HDR colours. Needs the overlay menu; SDR captures are unchanged.

keys.name: PreviewNRTrace
keys.description: Rate-limited trace log lines for the character preview path (finisher verdicts, evaluations, UI swaps). Only logs, changes nothing.

keys.name: ReShadeHighlights
keys.description: Mode 1: preserve measured scene highlights through ReShade's grading (experimental).

keys.name: UiExpansion
keys.description: Mode 1 interface curve: how far above paper white the interface expands. Follows HighlightExpansion when left on auto; a number overrides it for the interface only. Read by the continuous composition only; the legacy composition keeps using HighlightExpansion.

keys.name: LegacyComposition

menu.iniOnly: experimental rollback of the scene HDR composition: kept out of the menu until confirmed in a game

keys.description: Mode 1 composition: true keeps the two-rule composition of tagged previews and the colour band; false selects the continuous composition of world and interface light. Experimental, will become the default after in-game confirmation.

keys.name: Enabled
keys.description: Neural Rendering (the DLSS NR model) on the upscaled frame (ordinary super resolution, or super resolution combined with ray reconstruction), before frame generation sees it. Needs an installed NR runtime; undocumented and driven directly, so none of it is officially supported.

keys.name: WorkingScale
keys.description: What fraction of the frame the model works at. The frame itself is never reduced: only the model's own work is done small and enlarged. Cost falls with the square of this. Above 1.0 (DX12 and Vulkan) the model supersamples. ScaleUpKey and ScaleDownKey move it live between 25% and 200% (5% per press; only the uniform WorkingScale moves); TransferToggleKey flips the enlargement mode. All three hotkeys are unbound by default.

keys.name: WorkingScaleX
keys.description: A different model resolution per axis (DX12 only): the fraction of the frame width the model works at. Valid values are 0 (follows WorkingScale) or 0.25 to 2. Cost falls with the product of the two axes.

keys.name: WorkingScaleY
keys.description: A different model resolution per axis (DX12 only): the fraction of the frame height the model works at. Valid values are 0 (follows WorkingScale) or 0.25 to 2. Cost falls with the product of the two axes.

keys.name: Passes
keys.description: Number of sequential model layers between one encode and one final composition. 1 is normal; 2 and 3 cost almost exactly 2x and 3x the model time. Values are clamped to 1..3 (up to 30 with UnlockPasses on).

keys.name: Intensity
keys.description: How strongly each model pass edits the frame, for ordinary super resolution and combined ray reconstruction + super resolution. Pass 2 and 3 inherit pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Transfer
keys.description: How a reduced-resolution model result is enlarged. 0 enlarges the complete model output; 1 enlarges only its matched residual. No effect at WorkingScale 1.0 or above.

keys.name: TransferStrength
keys.description: How far the frame moves toward the model's picture. 0 gives back exactly what the upscaler produced, 1 is the model's picture, and above 1 carries on past it.

keys.name: RunBeforeSR
keys.description: Run NR before ordinary super resolution on the active colour input instead of after it. Both use WorkingScale and Passes. Before RR, NR processes noisy ray-traced colour: visual results need testing.

keys.name: DepthAwareResolve
keys.description: Depth-aware enlargement of a reduced model (DX12 only): weight each tap of the enlargement filter by how close the game's depth under it is to the depth under the output pixel, so the answer stops at object edges. Nothing at model resolution 100% or above, or while spatial compression is active.

keys.name: ClassicSharpen
keys.description: Sharpens the frame after the Classic enlargement (DX12 only), with an RCAS-style adaptive sharpen ported from upstream's RCAS. Only while the Classic enlargement applies: the model is reduced on some axis and above 100% on none, and the enlargement mode is not Matched residual. Debug views are never sharpened.

keys.name: ClassicSharpenStrength
keys.description: Strength of the Classic sharpening, 0 to 1 (0.4 is upstream RCAS's own default). 0 skips the step entirely; a value that cannot be read falls back to 0.4.

keys.name: Governor
keys.description: Frame-rate governor (experimental): steps the model resolution over 100/90/80/70/60/50% to hold the target frame rate. A run-time cap only: Model resolution stays the ceiling and is never written. Steps down after 3 s below 95% of the target; probes one tier up after 10 s at or above 97% of the target and keeps the probe only if the rate holds 97% of the target over the next 2 s. Stands down while AutoMFG, a per-axis model size or spatial compression is on. A frame-generation feature that reports itself active without an observed count is waited for 2 s at most; past that the present rate is used and the status line says so.

keys.name: GovernorTargetFps
keys.description: Frame rate the governor holds, in frames per second as displayed (frame generation included). 0 is auto: the lower of the frame rate limit and the display refresh rate. Manual values below 30 are raised to 30.

keys.name: GovernorProbe

menu.iniOnly: developer probe: logs once per model build whether a below-created-size evaluate exists; the governor never uses it

keys.description: Developer probe: once per model build, logs whether the model can evaluate below the size it was created for (works / refused / not available). Changes nothing on screen; the governor never uses it.

keys.name: DisableOnFocusLoss
keys.description: Experimental: pause NR while the game window is not the foreground window or is minimised, and resume with a clean history when the window is focused again. Does not change Enabled. Native Vulkan is not paused.

keys.name: SpatialCompression
keys.description: Experimental spatial compression of the model's work area (100% of the frame or less). Which profile it drives is SpatialProfile.

keys.name: SpatialProfile
keys.description: Which profile SpatialCompression drives: 0 Peripheral, 1 Foveated (a full-density centre of FoveaWidth x FoveaHeight pixels easing off over FoveaFalloff to FoveaEdgeX / FoveaEdgeY of the density). NR returns to the ordinary size by itself when the saving would be under 5%.

keys.name: ApplyModel
keys.description: Whether the model's edit is applied. Off keeps the pass running (so HoldFrame works) but shows the clean upscaler frame.

keys.name: Runtime
keys.description: Which NR model file runs. Leave on auto (or empty) for the newest installed, legacy for the old search, or a folder name such as NR.310.9. Changed live from the card; not part of the saved presets.

keys.name: Precision
keys.description: 0 = NVIDIA FP8 (default), 4 = experimental NVFP4 hybrid (coerced to {0,4} on load).

keys.name: DeferredDLSS
keys.description: Experimental: generate NR before SR, upscale its signed contribution with a private DLSS feature and apply it after SR. Takes precedence over RunBeforeSR. Requires a working DLSS SR runtime.

keys.name: PreSRTrailGuard
keys.description: Experimental current-frame bounds for the private PreSR contribution. Live toggle.

keys.name: SplitFrameWork
keys.description: Experimental alternating NR scheduling: NR on A, private SR/FG on B. Adds one more rendered frame of scene buffering.

keys.name: ResidualFG
keys.description: Experimental every-other-frame NR with NVIDIA FG on the residual layer. Delays SR colour one frame.

keys.name: ResidualFGApproxCamera
keys.description: Explicit consent to approximate camera transforms when full camera guides are absent.

keys.name: ToggleKey
keys.description: Virtual-key code toggling the pass in game. Unbound by default; set it from the Keybinds section of the overlay; -1 leaves it unbound.

keys.name: ScaleUpKey
keys.description: Virtual-key code raising the working size by 5% per press (25% to 200%). Only the uniform WorkingScale moves; -1 leaves it unbound.

keys.name: ScaleDownKey
keys.description: Virtual-key code lowering the working size by 5% per press (25% to 200%). Only the uniform WorkingScale moves; -1 leaves it unbound.

keys.name: TransferToggleKey
keys.description: Virtual-key code flipping the enlargement mode (Classic/Matched residual) in game. Does nothing while the Enlargement combo is greyed out; -1 leaves it unbound.

keys.name: ColourStrength
keys.description: Whether the model's colour arrives with its light. 0 keeps the game's own hue exactly; 1 brings the model's colour as well.

keys.name: MaxRatio
keys.description: The most the pass may brighten any pixel, as a multiple. Darkening is not capped.

keys.name: DebugView
keys.description: 0 off, 1 the picture the model sees, 2 its raw answer, 3 what it changed, amplified.

keys.name: Compare
keys.description: Side-by-side / wipe comparison of the pass against itself: 0 off, 1 side by side, 2 wipe.

keys.name: CompareSplit
keys.description: Wipe position for Compare = 2 (0..1).

keys.name: CompareZoom
keys.description: Compare zoom: 1 fits the frame in each half, 2 fills it. Side by side only.

keys.name: CompareSwap
keys.description: Which side the edited frame sits on in a comparison.

keys.name: CompareTags
keys.description: Labels drawn onto the two sides of a comparison.

keys.name: TagScale
keys.description: Size of the comparison labels.

keys.name: SpatialCenterX
keys.description: Spatial compression curve centre, percent (Peripheral profile only).

keys.name: SpatialCenterY
keys.description: Spatial compression curve centre, percent (Peripheral profile only).

keys.name: SpatialWorkX
keys.description: Spatial compression work area, percent (Peripheral profile only).

keys.name: SpatialWorkY
keys.description: Spatial compression work area, percent (Peripheral profile only).

keys.name: SpatialOffsetX
keys.description: Spatial placement offset; the Foveated profile uses it for placement.

keys.name: SpatialOffsetY
keys.description: Spatial placement offset; the Foveated profile uses it for placement.

keys.name: SpatialShiftX
keys.description: Spatial shift (Peripheral profile only).

keys.name: SpatialShiftY
keys.description: Spatial shift (Peripheral profile only).

keys.name: FoveaWidth
keys.description: Foveated full-density centre width, output pixels (clamped to the frame every frame).

keys.name: FoveaHeight
keys.description: Foveated full-density centre height, output pixels (clamped to the frame every frame).

keys.name: FoveaFalloff
keys.description: Foveated falloff length, output pixels (clamped to the frame every frame).

keys.name: FoveaEdgeX
keys.description: Foveated edge density on X (0.25..1).

keys.name: FoveaEdgeY
keys.description: Foveated edge density on Y (0.25..1).

keys.name: PassFeedback
keys.description: Spatial feedback between passes: 1 keeps the raw interpass output, below 1 gamut-bounds the edit and blends it back toward the preceding input.

keys.name: VitEvery
keys.description: Run the bottleneck on every Nth NR evaluation, 1..2. With VitFirstPassOnly only pass 1 is affected.

keys.name: VitAllowUnverified
keys.description: Experimental bottleneck reuse override for alternate runtimes. Bypasses only the module fingerprint check. Incompatible runtimes can corrupt or crash.

keys.name: VitCapture
keys.description: Profiling aid: records the CUDA launches of the first NR evaluations and dumps the ViT module. Never changes a launch. Set it before the game starts.

keys.name: ReplayCapture

menu.iniOnly: developer key: the capture triggers write a full replay set of the pass

keys.description: Developer tool: while on, a capture trigger (the dlssnr-capture.trigger file or AutoCapture) records a replay set of the NR pass (two frames, every dispatch with its inputs and outputs) instead of the before/after frames, for checking shader changes without the game. A capture shows the player's screen: never share it.

keys.name: VitFirstPassOnly
keys.description: Restrict bottleneck reuse to pass 1; later passes compute fully. Set false to restore reuse on every pass. Requires VitEvery=2.

keys.name: ScalingDownscaler
keys.description: Downscaler averaging the model's answer back to native when supersampling. 0 FSR1, 1 Bicubic, 2 CatmullRom, 3 Lanczos2, 4 Lanczos3, 5 Kaiser2, 6 Kaiser3, 7 MAGIC.

keys.name: AutoCapture
keys.description: Write one set of matched before/after frames per session after the capture delay (180 frames). No capture when off.

keys.name: ScanExposure
keys.description: Run the exposure scan even when WhitePointSource is not 2 (developer override).

keys.name: WhitePointSource
keys.defaultMeans: 1 (the exposure the game hands the upscaler)
keys.description: Where the white point comes from: 0 paper white slider, 1 exposure the game hands the upscaler, 2 scanned exposure. Linear buffers only.

keys.name: WhitePointScale
keys.description: Multiplies the white point before the encode (the paper-white control).

keys.name: WhitePointTrim
keys.description: Trim on an exposure-derived white point, kept apart from the manual divisor. 1.0 takes the game's exposure exactly.

keys.name: ScanTrim
keys.description: Trim on the scanned white point (WhitePointSource=2).

keys.name: ScanAnchors
keys.description: Scan calibration table, scan:white;scan:white;... ascending, written by the overlay's anchor buttons. Empty means no anchors.

keys.name: ScanInverted
keys.description: Whether the scan's number rises (false) or falls (true) with the light.

keys.name: ScanMeter
keys.description: Overlay lamp showing what the scan currently thinks the light is doing.

keys.name: LightingHistory
keys.description: FFXIV native scanned lighting: reset NR history on abrupt tone changes. Needs WhitePointSource=2 and a fresh verified scan.

keys.name: Preset
keys.description: Model profile baked into the feature: changing it causes a guarded feature rebuild. Values undocumented; not the SR/RR preset scale.

keys.name: Style
keys.description: Model style baked into the feature: 0 standard, 1 natural, 2 cinematic. Changing it causes a guarded feature rebuild.

keys.name: LocalStructure
keys.description: Local structure strength of the model (pass 1; passes 2 and 3 inherit it when left on auto).

keys.name: LocalTone
keys.description: Local tone strength of the model (pass 1; passes 2 and 3 inherit it when left on auto).

keys.name: SkinStructure
keys.description: -1 means follow local structure (the model's own default, not zero).

keys.name: AutoMask
keys.description: Automatic masking of the model's edit in the final composition.

keys.name: SkinProtection
keys.description: Optional colour-based final-edit filter (not NVIDIA's semantic auto mask). Preview before relying on it.

keys.name: SkinToneEnabled
keys.description: Whether the model's skin-tone handling applies.

keys.name: SkinDetail
keys.description: Skin detail strength of the model.

keys.name: SkinColour
keys.description: Skin colour strength of the model.

keys.name: EnvironmentDetail
keys.description: Environment detail strength of the model.

keys.name: EnvironmentColour
keys.description: Environment colour strength of the model.

keys.name: ShowSkinMask
keys.description: Show the skin mask (debug view of what the skin handling sees).

keys.name: UnlockPasses
keys.description: Optional extended range up to 30 passes. Normal ceiling remains 3; no extra work while off.

keys.name: ReversibleMode
keys.description: RenoDX reversible proxy mode: 0 soft-knee encode and our composition, 1/2 Neutwo composed/replace, 3/4 hybrid composed/replace, 5 linear light and composed.

keys.name: HoldFrame
keys.description: Freeze the NR pass's input so a live setting change re-renders the same frame.

keys.name: Pass2Preset
keys.description: Pass 2 override of the model profile (preset 0..3). Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass2Style
keys.description: Pass 2 override of the model style (0 standard, 1 natural, 2 cinematic). Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass2Intensity
keys.description: Pass 2 override of the model strength. Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass2LocalStructure
keys.description: Pass 2 override of the local structure strength. Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass2LocalTone
keys.description: Pass 2 override of the local tone strength. Auto keeps the legacy later-pass value 0.

keys.name: Pass2SkinStructure
keys.description: Pass 2 override of the skin structure (-1 follows structure). Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass2AutoMask
keys.description: Pass 2 override of the automatic masking. Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass3Preset
keys.description: Pass 3 override of the model profile (preset 0..3). Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass3Style
keys.description: Pass 3 override of the model style (0 standard, 1 natural, 2 cinematic). Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass3Intensity
keys.description: Pass 3 override of the model strength. Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass3LocalStructure
keys.description: Pass 3 override of the local structure strength. Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass3LocalTone
keys.description: Pass 3 override of the local tone strength. Auto keeps the legacy later-pass value 0.

keys.name: Pass3SkinStructure
keys.description: Pass 3 override of the skin structure (-1 follows structure). Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Pass3AutoMask
keys.description: Pass 3 override of the automatic masking. Inherits pass 1 when left on auto.

keys.name: Trace
keys.defaultMeans: auto (off at the normal log level; on only with file logging at Debug or Trace)

menu.iniOnly: diagnostic switch of the frame-pacing CPU trace

keys.description: Frame pacing trace: every 10 seconds, for each thread and place, one log line with call counts and CPU times. true = on at any log level, false = off, auto = on only with file logging at Debug or Trace. Runs only in FFXIV.

keys.name: GpuTimers
keys.defaultMeans: auto (off unless the trace above is on)

menu.iniOnly: diagnostic switch of the frame-pacing GPU stage timers

keys.description: GPU stage timers: sampled frames time the present copy-in, the ReShade effects and the D3D12 interop copy (true = on at any log level, false = off, auto = on only together with the trace). The interop line also carries a cpu offset in ms, the same samples placed on the CPU clock with the queue's own clock calibration (D3D11 has no such pairing). A timer never waits on the frame path. Add GpuTimers=true for a measurement run with Trace=true.

keys.name: HiddenPresentDoNotWait

menu.iniOnly: debug switch of the hidden DX11 present, compared with the trace

keys.description: The auxiliary present on the hidden swapchain gets DXGI_PRESENT_DO_NOT_WAIT and a busy chain skips that present instead of blocking. Off = exactly the old call.

keys.name: FgRecorder
keys.description: FG event recorder: one JSONL file per session in fg-recordings beside the DLL (presents with HRESULT, Reflex sleeps, AutoMFG lines, NR rebuilds, provider events). Bounded queue, rotation and session cap; off means no thread and no file.

keys.name: TickProbe

menu.iniOnly: measurement switch of the simulation-tick probe, no gameplay effect

keys.description: Simulation tick probe. Leases the game's own tick function once and timestamps every tick, bridge present and Reflex sleep on the thread that ran it; one log line every 10 seconds reports the tick period and body, the frame age, the queue wait, the slack and the sleep-to-tick distance, the threads, and the share of presents whose frame number found its tick. Ticks and presents are numbered by the game's own frame counter, so a frame age and queue wait are reported only when that counter resolved and advanced by exactly one per tick. Off = nothing is installed, nothing is read. FFXIV only.

keys.name: FlushAfterSignal

menu.iniOnly: experiment switch of the D3D11 to D3D12 hand-over, set in the ini only

keys.description: Flush the D3D11 context right after the fence Signal of the D3D11 to D3D12 hand-over, so its commands reach the driver then instead of at the game's own flush. An experiment: the cost is a driver flush and less batching, the possible gain is a shorter wait before the D3D12 side picks the frame up, and which side wins has not been measured. Off gives exactly the old hand-over.

keys.name: AdaMfgUnlock
keys.description: Optional built-in RTX 40 (Ada) multi frame generation unlock with targeted temporal correction. Memory-only, supported nvngx_dlssg.dll runtimes only, nvngx_dlssg.dll on disk is never modified. Never combine with an external unlocker. Save Settings and restart after changing.

keys.name: AutoMFG
keys.description: Experimental automatic multi frame generation multiplier for DLSS-G on RTX 40: picks 2x-4x from the real frame time and changes the count in place. Needs the Ada unlock above for anything over 2x. Never goes above 4x. Save Settings does not store the automatic choice.

keys.name: RenderPreset
keys.defaultMeans: 0 (Auto: the driver and the runtime decide)
keys.description: DLSS-G render preset for the built-in NVIDIA runtime. 0 = Auto, 1 = Preset A, 2 = Preset B, 3 = Preset C. The menu changes it while the game runs; Save Settings stores the choice.

keys.name: UIRecomposition
keys.defaultMeans: true (on while a hud-less source is in use)
keys.description: Separate UI path for DLSS-G. Only used while a hud-less image source delivers frames; read when the DLSS-G feature is created, so change it before the game starts. The menu writes false for Off and auto for Auto and On (they act the same).

keys.name: AutoMFGMax
keys.description: Highest multiplier the automatic mode may use: 2 (2x) to 4 (4x). Values outside 2..4 count as unset.

keys.name: AutoMFGTarget
keys.defaultMeans: 0 (auto: the lower of the frame rate limit and the display refresh rate)
keys.description: Frame rate the automatic mode aims for. 0 (auto) is the lower of the frame rate limit and the display refresh rate.

keys.name: AutoMFGSelfTest
keys.description: One-off maintainer check: changes the count 2x, 3x, 4x, 3x, 2x six seconds apart and logs PASS or FAIL. Needs AutoMFG on, a fixed 3X or 4X multiplier and the INFO log level.

keys.name: AmpereMfgUnlock
keys.description: RTX 20/30 multi frame generation through a companion DLSS-G runtime in OptiScaler/dlssg_sm86. Experimental. Do not enable together with the Ada unlock. Save Settings and restart after changing.

keys.name: AmpereMfgMaxFrames
keys.description: Largest number of generated frames the companion is configured for (1 = 2X ... 5 = 6X).

keys.name: AmpereMfgKernelImage
keys.description: Interpolation kernel image written to the companion ini: Auto, PTX or Cubin.

keys.name: AmpereMfgRouter
keys.defaultMeans: Auto (picks one for the detected GPU)
keys.description: Router written to the companion ini (Auto picks one for the detected GPU).

keys.name: AmpereMfgHardwareBilinear
keys.description: Hardware bilinear sampling in the companion kernels.

keys.name: AmpereMfgOptimized
keys.description: Companion optimisation level written to its ini.

keys.name: AmpereMfgPreset
keys.description: Companion preset written to its ini.

keys.name: AmpereMfgSpoofArchToGame
keys.description: Architecture the companion reports to the game.

keys.name: AmpereMfgLogLevel
keys.description: Companion log level 0..3.

keys.name: PreviewDLSS
keys.description: Experimental isolated DLSS Super Resolution for each character preview (render size N x M, output 2N x 2M, separate histories). Needs the game's own D3D11 DLSS setup. While the DLSS pass cannot run, the spatial AA is used instead.

keys.name: JitterCorrection
keys.description: Experimental: learn the ratio between the jitter the game applies to the picture and the jitter it reports to the upscaler, and scale the reported offsets by it for every DLSS evaluate (also frame generation and the DLSS-NR path). Meant to be switched on for a test and compared with it off. Test with frame generation off first.

keys.name: PreviewAA
keys.description: Spatial anti-aliasing of the equipment preview image. Used while PreviewDLSS is off, and while the PreviewDLSS pass cannot run.

keys.name: PreviewUpscale
keys.description: PreviewAA only: the filtered image is twice the size of the original (2x preview upscaling). If the equipment preview looks zoomed or cropped, turn this off.

keys.name: PreviewGuideCapture
keys.description: Diagnostics for the DLSS path: writes guide and image dumps into OptiScaler/PreviewDLSSDiagnostics, twice per session. Leave off unless investigating.

keys.name: PreviewDebugTint
keys.description: Debug aid: mixes a colour into the preview image (magenta for spatial AA or DLSS, cyan for preview NR), so the displayed image source is visible.

keys.name: PreviewNR
keys.description: Neural Rendering for each character preview through shared images. Needs an NVIDIA card, the bridge running and nvngx_dlssnr.dll. Uses the same DlssNr settings ([DlssNr] Enabled is not needed).

keys.name: PreviewNRLingerSeconds
keys.description: Seconds a preview's NR model is kept after its window closed, so reopening the window is instant. 0 releases it at once.

keys.name: PreviewNRLate
keys.description: Show the previous frame's NR result instead of waiting for this frame's (no GPU wait, one frame of lag). Native preview image only.

keys.name: PreviewNRBeforeSR
keys.description: Experimental: run the preview's NR on the picture before the DLSS step instead of after it. Only with PreviewDLSS and PreviewNR both on.

keys.name: PreviewProbe
keys.description: Debug probe tracing how the processed preview image reaches the screen; writes images and logs to OptiScaler/PreviewDebug. Costs texture lookups per draw while on.

keys.name: PreviewDebugFlood
keys.description: Debug aid: draws the preview as solid magenta wherever the game samples it, so the replacement reach is visible.

keys.name: JitterProbe
keys.description: Read-only look at the game's camera jitter: about every 10 seconds one log line compares applied vs reported jitter. Only reads game memory.

keys.name: JitterScaleOverride
keys.defaultMeans: 0 (off: the correction learns the ratio itself)
keys.description: Experiment: fixed scale for the reported jitter (0.25 to 1.0) instead of the learned ratio. 0 = off. Only used while JitterCorrection is on. The menu changes it live.

keys.name: JitterSource
keys.description: Experimental: fix the game's jitter at the source (full lattice, repeating cycle, told offsets). Falls back silently when unavailable. Test with frame generation off first.

keys.name: FfxivLegacyGameBuild

menu.iniOnly: persistent rollback switch of the game build handling, read once at start

keys.description: Rollback: exactly the behaviour before the address search existed. Use it to compare, or if the search misbehaves.

keys.name: FfxivUnknownBuildHooks

menu.iniOnly: persistent switch: the game-address features on a game build the table does not know

keys.description: The features that read or hook the game's code, on a game build the table has no entry for: allowed only when the search found every needed address. Has no effect on the supported build.

keys.name: FfxivForceUnknownBuild

menu.iniOnly: persistent debug switch: ignore the known-build table

keys.description: Debug: ignore the supported-build table, as if the game were patched, so the address search alone can be tried on today's executable. Leave off in normal use.

keys.name: AutomaticReShadeDepth
keys.description: Automatic scene depth for ReShade: copies the depth the upscaler is given into the back-buffer size for ReShade effects. Needs ReShade 6.8+. Switching it on takes effect within a few frames.

keys.name: DrawDiagnostics

menu.iniOnly: developer draw diagnostic: log only, writes the draw list of a few frames

keys.description: Developer switch, ini only: capture writes the draw order of a few complete frames to OptiScaler/draw-diag/<run>/ (draws.csv: one row per draw with its pixel shader CRC and stage, the reflected names of the resources and constant buffers it binds, every render target's format and size, the depth view, the viewport, blend and depth state and the tone map, first UI draw and upscale boundary markers; cb.csv: the g_LightParam position, direction and colour read back once a second). Nothing in the frame changes. The shader names are recorded when the game creates its shaders, so set it before the game starts. Any other value counts as off.

keys.name: DrawDiagnosticsFrames

menu.iniOnly: developer draw diagnostic: how many frames one capture writes

keys.description: Developer switch, ini only: how many complete frames one capture writes. Frames with fewer than 32 draws (loading screens) are skipped. 1 to 16; anything else is clamped.

keys.name: VfxMaskProbe

menu.iniOnly: a developer probe of the upscaler's mask input, not a player setting

keys.description: Developer probe, ini only: put a constant R8_UNORM mask the size of the picture into the upscaler's mask input, one half full and one half empty. left or right picks the masked half. Comparing two screenshots of the same still scene with it off and on shows whether the backend reads a mask at all: the unmasked half is the noise floor. Anything else reads as off, and nothing is written at all on a frame the probe cannot build a mask for.

keys.name: MipmapBiasAuto
keys.defaultMeans: true for FFXIV, false for other games
keys.description: Follow the upscaling ratio with the mipmap bias (log2 of render width over output width), so there is no number to work out by hand. A MipmapBiasOverride you set always wins and nothing is applied automatically then.

keys.name: MipmapBiasAutoOffset
keys.description: Added to the automatic value. Negative makes textures sharper, positive softer.

keys.name: MipmapBiasObserve

menu.iniOnly: a debug log switch for the bind-time mipmap bias

keys.description: Debug: log every distinct original sampler bias the game uses at each upscaling ratio. No menu control.

keys.name: DynamicMFG
keys.description: Automatic 2X-4X factor selection from the real frame timing, drawn into the XeFG menu row. The slider/InterpolationCount still picks Off/Default. The target is bounded by FramerateLimit.

keys.name: DynamicTargetFPS
keys.description: Target FPS for DynamicMFG, 30 - 500.

keys.name: UnlockMFG
keys.description: Unlocks multi frame generation in Intel's libxess_fg.dll by patching the loaded provider image in memory (the file on disk is never changed). The patches apply when the provider loads: applies after a restart. Turn it off if the provider misbehaves.

keys.name: MaxInterpolatedFrames
keys.description: Interpolated frames reported as the maximum once UnlockMFG is on (N = frames between two rendered frames, menu shows N+1: 1 = 2X ... 7 = 8X). Handed to the provider at swapchain creation: applies after a restart. Values outside 1..7 are ignored.

keys.name: ExtraPacing
keys.description: Spreads every generated frame above 2X out in time instead of presenting the burst back to back. Takes effect once, at XeFG init: needs a game restart.

keys.name: ResetOnUpscalerChange
keys.description: Rebuild the XeFG context when the upscaler is released (quality or NR change) so the provider's pacing history starts clean. Only used by games that isolate NGX shutdown (FFXIV).

keys.name: RenderSizeFromWidthHeight
keys.description: Take the render size from the Width/Height parameters rather than the render subrect. FFXIV only. Leave off unless the render size looks wrong.

keys.name: Style

menu.iniOnly: a theme preference read from the ini when the menu opens

keys.description: Menu style. classic is OptiScaler's own look; ember keeps surfaces neutral and uses the accent colour only to mark state. Anything else reads as classic.

keys.name: FsrMonotonicFrameId

menu.iniOnly: provider-internal FSR frame ID keep-alive, set in the ini only

keys.description: FSR frame generation resets its interpolation history when the frame ID it is given does not rise by exactly 1, and the shared dispatch selector lets that ID jump forward on a skipped frame or fall back after a quality change. On gives FSR its own ID, rising by exactly 1 per dispatch, and hands the provider's callbacks the buffer slot of the dispatch their ID belongs to. Affects the FSR output path only; DLSS-G and XeFG are untouched either way.

keys.name: SkipReleaseSleep

menu.iniOnly: kill switch of the release-path sleep skip

keys.description: Skip the 500 ms pause on upscaler release when the release proved nothing still uses the old upscaler. Off gives exactly the old behaviour.

keys.name: Enabled

menu.iniOnly: diagnostic switch of the generic status.json file beside the DLL

keys.description: Writes status.json next to the DLL (the game folder): a small versioned snapshot for bug reports and tools (versions, feature states, frame-time percentiles, the last writer error). Never holds a path, drive letter, user name or character name. Written atomically by a low-priority background thread, at most once a second on a change plus every 10 s; deleted again when the game exits. Schema in docs/notes/status-json.md.

keys.name: ForcePerfQuality
keys.description: Which quality preset the game is answered with: -1 leave the game's choice alone, 0 Max Performance, 1 Balanced, 2 Max Quality, 3 Ultra Performance, 4 Ultra Quality, 5 DLAA / native.

keys.name: Mode
keys.description: Window mode. off = nothing runs; probe = log only; on = probe plus the border fix and the deferred mode switch. Applies after a game restart. Any other value counts as off.

aliases.note: Another name for DisableOnFocusLoss, used by another build. DisableOnFocusLoss wins when both are set; the value moves into DisableOnFocusLoss when the ini is read. No menu control.
Another name for MipmapBiasAuto, used by another build. MipmapBiasAuto wins when both are set. No menu control.

families.note: Generated per-pass overrides for passes 4 to 30 (27 passes x 6 keys, bound by a loop in NrConfig::Bind, not by literal b.Add lines). An absent value inherits pass 1. Not one entry per key.

retired.note: Retired: menu HDR mapping is automatic; deleted from the ini on save.
Retired: the old fixed screenshot toggle; deleted from the ini on save.
Retired in v0.4.0: the FFXIV Companion plugin is no longer supported; ignored if present (the game draws its own nameplates).
Retired in v0.4.0 with HudReplacement; ignored if present.
Retired in v0.4.0: the hidden motion-scale override of the automatic ReShade depth; ignored if present.
